name: media-bridge
description: Generate images from chat with Nano Banana 2, FLUX, Stable Diffusion and more. One-click Google sign-in, free tier available.

default_provider.title: Default provider
default_provider.description: Which provider to use when the prompt does not name one. Leave empty to auto-pick the best configured one. Options: google, gemini, pollinations, fal, stability, openai, higgsfield

default_model.title: Default model
default_model.description: Model used with the default provider. Nano Banana 2 is gemini-3.1-flash-image, free FLUX is flux, Higgsfield is soul-2.

output_dir.title: Output directory
output_dir.description: Where generated images are saved. Leave empty for ~/media/images.
